summary:
FMLink publishes a vendor product announcement from Stance Healthcare introducing Camber, a new casegoods (patient room storage furniture) collection aimed at healthcare specifiers, designers, and facilities teams.

Product positioning: patient room storage should go beyond holding personal belongings, also supporting caregivers, withstanding daily use, and contributing to a welcoming care environment. Camber includes bedside tables and wardrobes in multiple sizes for diverse care settings.

Design and construction details: seamless thermofoil surfaces on tops, drawer fronts, doors, and toe kicks; fully radiused drawer and door fronts; short-overhang tops; matching three-quarter inch laminate backs for a refined, residential feel; and steel drawer boxes for durability in demanding environments.

Lifecycle and maintenance: tops, drawer fronts, doors, and toe kicks are field replaceable, letting facilities refresh appearance and extend product life as healthcare spaces evolve.

Customization: available in a single finish or with contrasting tops and fronts for subtle or statement looks. Options include black or brushed nickel handles, solid surface tops for bedside tables, gallery rails, plastic drawer liners, and casters for mobility. Custom dimensions are available, as are multiple locking solutions including top-drawer locks and various lock types to support patient safety and security.

Marketing: Camber is the newest addition to Stance Healthcare's casegoods portfolio and will be shown at the Healthcare Design (HCD) Expo at booth #1627. The piece is dated September 11, 2026, and the image is credited to Stance Healthcare.

This is promotional content with no research data, adoption statistics, or third-party commentary. It touches healthcare facilities furniture procurement rather than workplace technology, and contains nothing on visitor management, desk or room booking, hybrid policy, or workplace analytics.
